newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish premier says presence of Turkey's army in northern Iraq is about to end.
- Three Kuwaitis and two Iranians were arrested in Kuwait for attempting to assassinate a parliamentarian.
- Saudi south electricity company is to sign projects worth 1.159 billion riyals in the eastern province of Saudi Arabia.
- Iranian president-elect Khatami hopes for improved relations between Saudi Arabia and Iran.
- Around 600 Kuwaiti pilots and engineers may go on strike to demand increased wages.
